text: Assumption: The call of StopOffer() should occur before the destructor call to avoid receiving concurrent calls via the DM during destruction — is this correct?

rationale: SWS_DM_02212 deactivates the forwarding of requests, while SWS_DM_02211 and SWS_DM_02212 are declared as not thread-safe.
